issues.description: The solution repository changes the visibility of PersonService.savePerson from public (as in the template) to private, while the REST controller (PersonResource) in the solution still calls savePerson. This is a structural visibility mismatch that would prevent PersonResource from compiling / accessing the method and is inconsistent with the template and the problem description that expects the service method to be callable from the resource layer.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore the savePerson method to public visibility (matching the template and intended service API) so that PersonResource can call it, or alternatively expose an appropriate public service method for creating/updating persons and update PersonResource accordingly. Ensure template, solution, and documentation consistently show the same visibility.
